project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Uppercase project identity constrained to letters, digits, and hyphens.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; Lightning runtime behavior does not read it.

site_address.label: Site address
site_address.help: Human-readable location; routing and evaluation use coordinates.

site_extent_radius_m.label: Site extent
site_extent_radius_m.help: Distance from centroid to site boundary; it widens every qualifying ring (INV-LTG-02).

red_radius_m.label: Red radius
red_radius_m.help: STOP radius before site extent and uncertainty are added; valid range 1–100000 metres (INV-LTG-02).

red_detection_types.label: Red detection types
red_detection_types.help: Non-empty subset of G ground and C cloud detections; ground-only by default.

red_dwell_seconds.label: Red dwell
red_dwell_seconds.help: STOP persists while a qualifying detection is strictly younger than this duration (INV-LTG-03).

amber_radius_m.label: Amber radius
amber_radius_m.help: WATCH radius; a red radius wider than amber is permitted (INV-LTG-14).

amber_detection_types.label: Amber detection types
amber_detection_types.help: Non-empty subset of G ground and C cloud detections; both by default.

amber_dwell_seconds.label: Amber dwell
amber_dwell_seconds.help: WATCH persistence and amber-delivery debounce interval (INV-LTG-10).

amber_enabled.label: Amber enabled
amber_enabled.help: Disables amber evaluation entirely and makes STOP clear directly to SAFE; it is not merely a message mute (INV-LTG-13).

ground_uncertainty_m.label: Ground uncertainty
ground_uncertainty_m.help: Added to the G trigger ring; raising it produces more qualifiers, not fewer (INV-LTG-02).

cloud_uncertainty_m.label: Cloud uncertainty
cloud_uncertainty_m.help: Added to the C trigger ring; raising it produces more qualifiers, not fewer (INV-LTG-02).

feed_stale_after_seconds.label: Feed stale after
feed_stale_after_seconds.help: Feed age that adds the DEGRADED overlay; degradation never downgrades STOP (INV-LTG-05).

max_consecutive_fetch_failures.label: Maximum fetch failures
max_consecutive_fetch_failures.help: Consecutive source failures tolerated before the DEGRADED overlay.

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: HTTPS listener endpoint required before enabled can become true.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

whatsapp_group_id.label: WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_group_id.help: Delivery destinations required and non-blank before enablement.

sms_whatsapp_group_id.label: SMS WhatsApp groups
sms_whatsapp_group_id.help: Optional dedicated destinations for signed SMS lightning alerts; blank falls back to whatsapp_group_id (INV-LTG-23).

poc_phone_numbers.label: POC phone numbers
poc_phone_numbers.help: Comma-separated international numbers used for red-band mentions.

poc_alert_wa_groups.label: POC mention groups
poc_alert_wa_groups.help: Only these destinations may receive red mentions; blank fails closed to no mentions.

enable_red_band_poc_mentions.label: Red POC mentions
enable_red_band_poc_mentions.help: Requires both POC lists to be non-blank in the same database write.

enable_sms_lightning_alerts.label: SMS lightning forwarding
enable_sms_lightning_alerts.help: Allows signed SMS alerts to be forwarded; it is separate from enabled and never feeds NEA state (INV-LTG-23).

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Master processing switch; the database requires complete HTTPS delivery configuration before enabling (INV-LTG-17).

working_hours_start_hhmm.label: Working-hours start
working_hours_start_hhmm.help: HHMM start; must be configured together with the end.

working_hours_end_hhmm.label: Working-hours end
working_hours_end_hhmm.help: Exclusive HHMM end; equal values are rejected and overnight windows are supported.

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses ordinary Sunday notifications but never a green that closes a delivered STOP (INV-LTG-11).

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses ordinary holiday notifications; the built-in Singapore list ends after 2027 (INV-LTG-12).

config_version.label: Config version
config_version.help: Evidence version that must be bumped in the same write as every policy edit; no trigger does it automatically (INV-LTG-16).

constraints.name: lightning_enabled_delivery_check
constraints.help: An enabled row requires an HTTPS lambda_url and non-blank instance_name, client_id, and whatsapp_group_id.

constraints.name: lightning_red_poc_mentions_check
constraints.help: Red mentions require both phone and destination lists.

constraints.name: lightning_working_hours_check
constraints.help: Working-hours start and end must both be null or both valid, unequal HHMM values.
